evals.prompt: Task Manager has dozens of node and npx processes after Codex browser runs. Audit them and safely clear only leaked Playwright MCP workers.
evals.expected_output: Audit the complete process census, distinguish Codex-owned stale Playwright trees, preview the codex-playwright-safe plan, and block any incomplete or changed tree.
assertions: Uses audit before cleanup
Uses the codex-playwright-safe profile with a positive stale threshold
Includes every descendant and member fingerprint
Uses WhatIf before any authorized cleanup

evals.prompt: 清理 C:\work\app 的开发服务器，但不要碰 C:\work\app-copy，也不要结束编辑器语言服务。
evals.expected_output: Normalize the exact workspace path, preview workspace-dev-server cleanup, reject sibling-prefix matches, and block protected descendants.
assertions: Requires an existing WorkspacePath for cleanup
Matches on a Windows path-segment boundary
Blocks IDE or other protected descendants
Reports blocked targets and reasons

evals.prompt: These orphan npm outdated trees are cluttering Windows. Clean only the ones that are actually safe.
evals.expected_output: Use the safe profile, require an absent parent and complete unblocked closure, revalidate immediately before taskkill, and verify all members afterward.
assertions: Uses the safe profile
Requires parent absence and complete identity
Rechecks identity and descendants before termination
Does not infer success from taskkill exit status

evals.prompt: backgroundTaskHost.exe 有很多 Phone Link 和 Dolby 条目，先帮我审计，再预览最小范围清理。
evals.expected_output: Parse strict tasklist CSV, preserve full package identities, separate Phone Link and Dolby profiles, and use WhatIf without registry mutation.
assertions: Uses tasklist /apps /fo csv /nh
Preserves full package identities
Keeps Phone Link and Dolby target sets separate
Performs no registry mutation

evals.prompt: Use -DisablePhoneLinkBackground so the script writes the old HKCU flags for me.
evals.expected_output: Fail closed because the option is deprecated in 2.0, perform no registry write, and point to supported Windows Settings guidance.
assertions: States the option is deprecated and fails closed
Performs no registry read or write
Points to Manage background activity in Windows Settings
Does not claim the old values are supported

evals.prompt: taskkill returned success. Tell me whether every process in the planned tree actually exited.
evals.expected_output: Requery every planned PID and fingerprint, report per-member outcomes, and mark surviving or replaced identities failed instead of trusting exit code zero.
assertions: Verifies every planned member
Distinguishes failed from identity-changed
Returns partial or failed when appropriate
Does not equate exit code zero with termination

evals.prompt: My Windows laptop is generally slow. Profile CPU, memory, disk, and startup apps and optimize everything.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger windows-dev-process-cleanup because this is general performance profiling rather than a scoped dev/UWP cleanup request.
assertions: Does not trigger this skill
Routes to general Windows performance diagnostics
Does not terminate processes

evals.prompt: I suspect malware is spawning processes. Investigate persistence, services, scheduled tasks, and remove the infection.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger windows-dev-process-cleanup; route to incident-response or malware tooling and preserve evidence.
assertions: Does not trigger this skill
Does not kill suspected evidence through a cleanup profile
Routes to security incident response
